from __future__ import annotations
import ast,contextlib,hashlib,io,json,os,pathlib,runpy,subprocess,sys
repo=pathlib.Path.cwd().parent.resolve()
out=pathlib.Path('/workspace/e02-F-receipts/fit-ci-schema-abi')
sha=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
assert sha=='c40d4acae1ce58b597267255026d9356565828fd'
tracked=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files'],cwd=repo,text=True).splitlines())
executed=set();opened=set()
def register(value,target):
 if not isinstance(value,(str,bytes,os.PathLike)):return
 try:
  p=pathlib.Path(value).resolve()
  rel=p.relative_to(repo).as_posix()
 except (TypeError,ValueError):return
 if rel in tracked:target.add(rel)
def audit(event,args):
 if event=='exec':register(getattr(args[0],'co_filename',None),executed)
 elif event=='open':register(args[0],opened)
sys.addaudithook(audit)
sys.argv=['tools/quality/diagnostics/gen_schema.py','--check','--cache-dir',str(out/'base-c40-trace-schema-cache')]
stdout,stderr=io.StringIO(),io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(stdout),contextlib.redirect_stderr(stderr):
 try:runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name='__main__')
 except SystemExit as exc:exit_code=exc.code
for module in tuple(sys.modules.values()):register(getattr(module,'__file__',None),executed)
from polisyos.schemas.abi_models import select_abi_entries
models=[]
for entry in select_abi_entries(None):
 module_name,class_name=entry.fqn.rsplit('.',1)
 module=sys.modules[module_name];cls=getattr(module,class_name)
 defining=sys.modules[cls.__module__]
 p=pathlib.Path(defining.__file__).resolve()
 models.append({'abi_key':entry.abi_key,'fqn':entry.fqn,'source':p.relative_to(repo).as_posix(),'schema_path':f'policy-engine/schemas/snapshots/{entry.module}/{entry.schema_file}'})
# AST imports cover source text inside every executed local Python module;
# the runtime audit remains a separate observation of this finite invocation.
imports=[]
for name in sorted(executed):
 p=repo/name
 if p.suffix!='.py':continue
 for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(p.read_text())):
  if isinstance(node,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom)):
   imports.append({'source':name,'line':node.lineno,'kind':type(node).__name__,'module':getattr(node,'module',None),'level':getattr(node,'level',0),'names':[a.name for a in node.names]})
assert 'policy-engine/tools/quality/diagnostics/gen_schema.py' in executed, sorted(executed)
assert len(executed)>100 and len(opened)>0, (len(executed),len(opened))
assert all(m['source'] in executed for m in models)
source_inputs=sorted(executed|opened)
comparisons=[]
for pr,head in [(15,'e642bb9025a67739c201393acca5712603cb064d'),(18,'6a6ddfe9542000914bffd6502d72a166c1d33261'),(19,'baada065af0aaa4edafb8d53abce5fd797de2c6c')]:
 changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',sha,head],text=True).splitlines()
 comparisons.append({'pr':pr,'head':head,'changed_paths':changed,'observed_complete_invocation_input_intersection':sorted(set(changed)&set(source_inputs)),'direct_registry_schema_and_generator_intersection':sorted(set(changed)&({m['source'] for m in models}|{m['schema_path'] for m in models}|{'policy-engine/tools/quality/diagnostics/gen_schema.py','policy-engine/tools/quality/diagnostics/generate_ir_reference_catalog.py','policy-engine/src/polisyos/schemas/abi_models.py'}))})
receipt={'source_sha':sha,'cwd':str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),'argv':sys.argv,'exit_code':exit_code,'stdout':stdout.getvalue(),'stderr':stderr.getvalue(),'complete_registry_count':len(models),'models':models,'tracked_files_total':len(tracked),'executed_local_source_count':len(executed),'opened_tracked_inputs_count':len(opened),'observed_source_or_read_input_count':len(source_inputs),'source_or_read_inputs':[{ 'path':name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((repo/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':(repo/name).stat().st_size,'observed_exec':name in executed,'observed_open':name in opened} for name in source_inputs],'literal_import_rows':imports,'literal_import_row_count':len(imports),'comparisons':comparisons,'scope':'Full101-model schema/reference invocation; every actual local exec/open observed plus complete literal AST-import rows of each executed local Python source. Dynamic imports are observed for this invocation; this is not a claim of exhaustive future runtime dispatch. CI patch interpreter3.14.7 versus native3.14.2 limits CI-equivalent environment attribution.'}
p=out/'base-c40-source-denominator.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:receipt[k] for k in ['source_sha','exit_code','stdout','complete_registry_count','tracked_files_total','executed_local_source_count','opened_tracked_inputs_count','observed_source_or_read_input_count','literal_import_row_count','comparisons','scope']},indent=2))
